findings.claim: FY2025 直銷約占總淨銷售 75%，其餘經第三方經銷商間接銷售；一手文件未描述通路或商業模式的結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: We sell our products into approximately 130 countries primarily through direct selling efforts to manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, our direct sales represented approximately 75% of total net sales. We also sell our products indirectly via third-party distributors.

findings.excerpt: AFFECTS USA CUSTOMERS - Distribution Center change from Tullahoma, TN to El Paso, TX Description of Changes This is a notiﬁcation only that our current shipping location will change as described.
